title: Household Checks on Live Animal Purchases under the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
A live animal purchase under the Live Pet Health Guarantee is checked against the customer's whole household on record, not against the single purchase alone.

## Rule

1. **Species pairing.** The species pairing restrictions of the guarantee type are applied to the animals of the customer's active guarantees. The animals a customer already holds under guarantees whose status is active are the household the new purchase is checked against; a guarantee whose status is claimed or expired is not an active guarantee.
2. **State permits.** The permit-state list of the guarantee type is applied to the customer's shipping state, that is, the state of the default shipping address on the customer's profile.
3. **Multi-animal discount.** The multi-animal discount applies per purchase line of at least the number of animals the guarantee type requires for it.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition examined | Record it is judged from | Result under the rule |
|---|---|---|
| A pairing restriction of the type would be met by the new animals together with animals of the customer's active guarantees | the customer's active guarantees | the listed species is not sold to share a habitat with those animals |
| The customer's shipping state is a state listed for the type | the shipping state on the customer's profile | the species group needs a permit there and is not sold |
| A purchase line has at least the required number of animals of the same species | the quantity on that purchase line | the multi-animal discount applies to that line |

## Points of judgement

- The discount is decided line by line. Hypothetical illustration: where a type requires a given minimum, a line holding exactly that many animals qualifies, and a line one animal short does not qualify even when the customer buys further animals of the same species on another line.
- The permit check reads the shipping state on the profile; a different state mentioned in conversation is not the record the check is applied to.
- Hypothetical illustration: a customer whose active guarantees include a rabbit asks to buy a guinea pig under the Small Animal Guarantee, whose pairing restriction is rabbits with guinea pigs; the restriction is applied with the rabbit counted as part of that household. Had the rabbit's guarantee been claimed or expired, it would not be an active guarantee of the household.
